definition: a person whose job is to cut down trees
description: A flat cartoon illustration on a cream background with beige cloud shapes and small dots. A very broad man with a brown beard, a blue knitted cap, a red-orange shirt, braces and black boots strides to the left. He carries a big axe over one shoulder and a cut log under his other arm. His legs and boots move in a walking loop, his body bobs up and down, and the dots around him move. With his axe and the cut log he is carrying, he is a lumberjack: a man whose job is to cut down trees.
